stable.headline: Edit mesh keeps up with big models
notes: A very big part is read in the background as soon as you go into Edit mesh.
Points mode shows up to two million points.
Moving picked pieces on a part of millions of triangles takes half a second, not five.
The box picks quickly on a big part, and many picked pieces no longer slow the view.
Merge by group names the merged part after its group.
Fixes for Dissolve, colours in the CAD view and staying in Edit mesh.
